ValidationRule.description: CJ: Created for NZC Implantation UC001_US05 Validation to make other stationary asset type text field mandatory when stationary asset type is selected to other
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StationaryAssetType , 'other'), ISBLANK(OtherStnryAstType__c ) ) || AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(StationaryAssetType , 'other')), NOT(ISBLANK(OtherStnryAstType__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Other Stationary Asset Type Is Required Only When Stationary Asset Type value is Other"
